subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Feeble
solution:
The correct answer is "**Weak.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• "**Feeble**" **means lacking physical strength or frail.**

 
 
• Example: She is very old and feeble now.
 
 
 
 
 
• Synonyms of feeble are weak, frail, delicate, and powerless.
 
 
• "**Weak**"** means having little energy or strength; not strong.**
 
 
• Example: The child was very weak.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "weak" is the synonym of the word "feeble."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unheedful** means not paying attention or careless.
 
• **Strong** means having great physical power or mental abilities.
 
• **Baneful** means harmful or destructive.
